Get SSL Exempted Urls
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/sslSettings/exemptedUrls
DEPRECATED

This endpoint has been deprecated and may be replaced or removed in future versions of the API.

Gets a list of URLs that were exempted from SSL Inpection and policy evaluation.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
urls
string[]

Domains or URLs which are exempted from SSL Inspection
